chat.request: PWS-Decisions has no chat request of its own, so each question goes out as the benchmark's request (the state, the question's instructions, its choices as lettered options) in the site's English chat prompts, one question per request; the reply is one letter and a 0-1 confidence in JSON, scored with PWS-Decisions' scorer.
chat.system_prompt: You are taking an English multiple-choice benchmark. Select exactly one supplied option per question and state your confidence in each answer. Do not explain.
chat.instruction: Answer each of the following multiple-choice questions. Without explanation, return for each question the letter of the correct option together with a confidence score between 0 and 1 showing how sure you are that your answer is correct, in the specified JSON format.
chat.setting: each model's best Text tab setting (highest Turkish accuracy)
